data.explanation: Your dentist's office is reminding you of your upcoming professional teeth cleaning appointment. Just show up at the stated time. If something comes up and you cannot make it, call or email the practice at least two business days beforehand so they can offer the slot to someone else; there's no fixed penalty mentioned, but short-notice cancellations are discouraged. No payment or form is required now.
